mapper.select: SELECT id,employee_no,real_name,password_hash,dept_id,status,employment_status,deleted FROM sys_user WHERE employee_no=#{employeeNo} FOR UPDATE

SELECT u.id,u.employee_no,u.real_name,u.dept_id,u.status,u.employment_status,u.deleted FROM sys_login_session s JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=s.user_id WHERE s.token_hash=#{tokenHash} AND s.revoked_at IS NULL AND s.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
SELECT dept_name FROM sys_dept WHERE id=#{deptId}
SELECT r.id,r.role_name,r.role_code,r.data_scope FROM sys_role r JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id=r.id WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND r.status=1 AND r.deleted=0 ORDER BY r.id

SELECT DISTINCT p.* FROM sys_permission p JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id=p.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=rp.role_id JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id=r.id WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND r.status=1 AND r.deleted=0 AND p.status=1 ORDER BY p.sort_no,p.id
SELECT * FROM sys_permission WHERE status=1 ORDER BY sort_no,id
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET last_login_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{userId}
UPDATE sys_login_session SET revoked_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE token_hash=#{tokenHash} AND revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE sys_login_session SET revoked_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user_role(user_id,role_id) SELECT #{userId},id FROM sys_role WHERE role_code='SUPER_ADMIN' AND deleted=0 AND status=1
